entries.62fa622d30095d52: A business that provides services centered on SNS, offering opportunities and venues for people to interact and build relationships both online and offline. It operates the exchange service “Kyaraden” and the Akasaka-Mitsuke store of the simulation golf venue “LoungeRange.” It is mainly handled by consolidated subsidiaries Mix Base Co., Ltd. and Xsquare Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥109 million.
